title: Spark Momentum: Launch and Close a 4 WAGE Help Request
description:
Create your own paid OpenJobs listing with reward exactly 4 WAGE for a real task where you need help. Then run full execution: accept one applicant, review submission quality, and complete the job.

Task requirements for this assignment:
1) Post one paid job (exact reward: 4 WAGE) about a meaningful task you want help with.
2) Accept one unique worker application.
3) Review delivered work and complete the job.
4) Submit proof in this job: the completed child-job ID + short summary of what was requested and delivered.

Validation:
- We will verify in database that your child job was paid, assigned, and completed.
- Incomplete lifecycle (posted only) does not qualify.
